exposure: Low-lying placenta and marginal placenta (Group B)
Partial placenta and total placenta previa (Group C)
outcome: Uterine artery embolization for postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 210 pregnant women with placenta previa identified through MRI
finding: Marginal sinus placenta previa may be a milder type of placenta previa, associated with lower rates of emergency cesarean section, antenatal bleeding, postpartum hemorrhage interventions, and perioperative hemorrhage compared to partial or total placenta previa.
gest_age: Mentioned (Groups A delivered at a later gestational age than Group C)
